title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (P300) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 31 healthy participants performing a row/column P300 speller task, with three sessions per subject. It is the P300 portion of a multimodal Eye-BCI collection that also includes eye-tracking and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms. Recordings were made with a 64-channel EEG cap plus EOG, and target and non-target flash events are annotated with HED.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap (64 EEG channels plus one EOG channel) and SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz, referenced to the right mastoid (M1) with a forehead ground. Participants used a visual row-column flash speller with 4L and 5L grid sizes in an offline, synchronous paradigm. The P300-4L default gives 40 trials per session, 2520 trials over 63 sessions.
